notes: The dispense needle's lever arm: add offset.dx_mm/dy_mm to a CAMERA pose on
'device' to get the pose that puts the NEEDLE there, and offset.dz_mm to a
FOCUSED camera Z to reach the height the needle touches at. All values are
RAW AXIS coordinates of 'device' - the camera and the needle ride the same
gantry, so this delta never crosses a frame and must never be pushed through
This is the SHIPPED SEED and it is deliberately valid:false, so every
dispense step refuses until the machine has actually been calibrated. Fill
dx_mm/dy_mm in with a tape-measure estimate (or type one on the Needle page)
and the first calibration has somewhere to aim - with nothing at all, the
first imprint lands a hundred millimetres outside a three-millimetre field of
view and there is nothing on screen to click.
A completed calibration is written to config/needle_cal.local.json, which is
gitignored and loads in preference to this file. Do not hand-edit that one -
the Needle page (F7) shows it and re-measures it.
